Stacking preset: floor + 5 boxes
Precondition: 6 bodies

Switch the rigid bodies to PBR (shaded) rendering
Change: the mode is now shaded
Precondition: top box starts high
Let the stack fall and settle under gravity
Change: the stack settled -- bottom box near the floor
Invariant: top box still above the bottom box
Both modes at once (wire over shaded)
Screenshot: the settled Stacking preset rendered in PBR + wire overlay
Preset switch (6 boxes -> 7 spheres) reconciles the shaded instances
Precondition: 7 bodies (floor + cue + 5-ball rack + ... )
Let the cue ball strike the rack
Screenshot: Billiards rendered in PBR after the break
Invariant: the app is still alive after the mode switches + preset reconcile + captures
Custom scene (floor only) so we can place large bodies in the middle of the shared camera's view
A large box near the camera target (20,20,20)
A large sphere beside it
Precondition: floor + box + sphere
Shaded only
Let them start falling
Screenshot: a big PBR box + sphere centred in the shared camera
Restore the default wireframe mode
Neg: an unknown render mode is rejected
